name: Ragdoll
teaser: Lets you mess with the applied forces to ragdolls and the time in which they stay in ragdoll mode.
description_html:
SPT 3.8.3

Lets you mess with the applied forces to ragdolls and the time in which they stay in ragdoll mode.

Values are in the bepinex config (f12)

I had this whole implementation for live ragdolls but i couldn’t get it to work properly.

The force is affected by the penetration power (ammunition used and i guess how much the armor is)

In any case, enjoy. setting the max force at 2000 in the bepinex config is

Sometimes they may still get partially stuck in walls especially with a high force.

Install to your bepinex/plugins folder as usual.
